Definition: from the same as G1075; tracing by generations, i.e. "genealogy":--genealogy.
BiblicalUsage: genealogía means genealogy. It turns up twice, in 1 Timothy and Titus.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe genealogía needs no more than its plain sense — genealogy.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
